item.title: Noxubee’s Taylor to represent state in Mississippi/Alabama All-Star Game on Saturday
item.description: Even though the high school football season is over, there’s still one more game left to play for Noxubee County’s Jadien Taylor. The post Noxubee’s Taylor to represent state in Mississippi/Alabama All-Star Game on Saturday appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: NASCAR settles federal antitrust case, gives all teams the permanent charters they wanted
item.description: Michael Jordan and NASCAR chairman Jim France stood side-by-side on the steps of a federal courthouse as if they were old friends following a stunning settlement Thursday of a bruising antitrust case in which the Basketball Hall of Famer was the lead plaintiff in a lawsuit accusing the top racing series in the United States of being a monopolistic bully. The post NASCAR settles federal antitrust case, gives all teams the permanent charters they wanted appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: MyPillow founder and Trump supporter Mike Lindell says he’s running for Minnesota governor in 2026
item.description: Mike Lindell, the fervent supporter of President Donald Trump known to TV viewers as the “MyPillow Guy,” officially entered the race for Minnesota governor Thursday in hopes of winning the Republican nomination to challenge Democratic Gov. Tim Walz in 2026. The post MyPillow founder and Trump supporter Mike Lindell says he’s running for Minnesota governor in 2026 appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Archaeologists uncover intact section of ancient Jerusalem wall from Hanukkah era
item.description: Archaeologists have finished uncovering the longest continuous remains of an ancient wall that encircled Jerusalem, including possible evidence of a 2,100-year-old ceasefire between warring kingdoms. The post Archaeologists uncover intact section of ancient Jerusalem wall from Hanukkah era appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Noem links the seizure of an oil tanker off Venezuela to US antidrug efforts
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem on Thursday linked the seizure of an oil tanker off the coast of Venezuela to the Trump administration’s counterdrug efforts in Latin America as tensions escalate with the government of President Nicolás Maduro. The post Noem links the seizure of an oil tanker off Venezuela to US antidrug efforts appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Alabama commission approves licenses for medical marijuana dispensaries as program eyes 2026 start
item.description: The Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission on Thursday approved licenses for dispensaries, a key step to making medical marijuana available in the state after years of delay. The post Alabama commission approves licenses for medical marijuana dispensaries as program eyes 2026 start appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Bulldogs head to Utah in need of new heroes
item.description: Mississippi State men’s basketball looked to be at a tipping point on Sunday in a loss to San Francisco at Cadence Bank Arena in Tupelo. The post Bulldogs head to Utah in need of new heroes appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Tariffs have cost US households $1,200 each since Trump returned to the White House, Democrats say
item.description: Sweeping taxes on imports have cost the average American household nearly $1,200 since Donald Trump returned to the White House this year, according to calculations by Democrats on Congress’ Joint Economic Committee. The post Tariffs have cost US households $1,200 each since Trump returned to the White House, Democrats say appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.description: For years now, the city of Columbus has struggled to create and maintain a viable economic development strategy. The post Our View: Local expertise is valuable — but not without guardrails and leadership appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Trump’s handling of the economy is at its lowest point in AP-NORC polling
item.description: President Donald Trump’s approval on the economy and immigration have fallen substantially since March, according to a new AP-NORC poll, the latest indication that two signature issues that got him elected barely a year ago could be turning into liabilities as his party begins to gear up for the 2026 midterms. The post Trump’s handling of the economy is at its lowest point in AP-NORC polling appeared first on The Dispatch.
